purpose: Show a founder which slow jobs AI can take off the team, what changes in one real-looking process, and that a person still checks the work.

seo.title: Solve problems with AI | Alliance AI Partners
seo.description: Automation and AI agents, customer support, knowledge and data, design, and security from Alliance AI Partners. AI does the repetitive steps; a person checks the result.

content.heading: Hand over the repetitive part.
content.lead: Five groups of services. Each one takes a job off your team, from typing up orders to answering the phone, and a person reviews the result before it reaches you or your customers.

items.title: AI integration and automation
items.text: We connect your software with tools like Make, n8n, and Zapier, and hand repetitive tasks to AI.

items.title: AI agents
items.text: Software that finishes multi-step jobs on its own, like processing an order or researching a lead, and checks with a person when it’s unsure.

items.title: Teams of AI agents
items.text: Several agents split up a big job and check each other’s work.

items.title: Document processing
items.text: We pull the data out of invoices, contracts, forms, and receipts and put it where it belongs.

items.title: AI for older software
items.text: For systems with no easy way to connect, AI can operate the program the way a person would.

items.title: Back-office automation
items.text: Data entry, inbox sorting, invoice matching, and HR paperwork, handled by AI.

items.title: Meeting assistants
items.text: Automatic meeting notes, with action items sent straight to your CRM.

items.title: AI-assisted support
items.text: Tools that help your support team answer customers faster.

items.title: Website and app chat assistants
items.text: A chat assistant that answers questions at any hour and passes harder cases to your team.

items.title: AI voice agents and receptionists
items.text: AI answers phone calls in a natural voice, books appointments, and takes messages.

items.title: Messaging assistants
items.text: Replies to customers on WhatsApp, SMS, Instagram, and Facebook Messenger.

items.title: Help desk automation
items.text: Support tickets get sorted and routed automatically, with draft replies for your team to approve.

items.title: Call insights
items.text: We record and summarize support and sales calls and flag the ones a manager should hear.

items.title: Multilingual support
items.text: Serve customers in their own language, with AI handling the translation.

items.title: Knowledge assistants
items.text: An assistant that answers staff questions using your company’s own documents.

items.title: Data cleanup and pipelines
items.text: We organize and connect your data so AI has something reliable to work with.

items.title: Talk to your data
items.text: Ask questions in plain English and get charts and answers back.

items.title: Forecasting
items.text: Predictions for demand and stock levels, so you can plan ahead.

items.title: Recommendations and personalization
items.text: Each customer sees the products or content they’re most likely to want.

items.title: UI/UX design powered by AI
items.text: We design apps and websites that are easy to use, with AI speeding up the design work.

items.title: Prototypes and user testing
items.text: Clickable prototypes tested with real users, with AI helping sort through the feedback.

items.title: Chat and voice design
items.text: We plan how your AI assistants talk, so conversations feel natural and match your brand.

items.title: AI security testing
items.text: We test AI apps and agents for weak spots, like attempts to trick them into leaking data, and fix what we find.

items.title: Fraud and anomaly detection
items.text: Unusual payments or logins get flagged as they happen.

items.title: Security monitoring with AI
items.text: AI watches your systems for threats and alerts your team fast.

content.heading: One slow process, before and after.
content.lead: A sample: orders that arrive by email. Today someone retypes each one. After, AI enters it and a person checks anything unusual.

items.title: Before · Every order, by hand
items.text: An order arrives by email (Inbox) · Someone retypes it into your order system (By hand) · Someone checks stock in another tab (By hand) · Someone writes the confirmation (By hand)

items.title: After · AI does the typing. A person checks.
items.text: An order arrives by email (Inbox) · AI reads it and enters it in your order system (AI) · AI checks stock and flags anything unusual (AI) · A person approves anything flagged (Person)

items.title: An owner and a backup plan
items.text: Every automation has both, and we write down how it works clearly enough for a new hire to follow.

items.title: Your data stays yours
items.text: Partner data stays where you decide, and we never use it to train anything you don’t own.

content.heading: Before you hand anything over.
content.lead: Straight answers about mistakes, your software, your data and the price.

faq.q: What if the AI gets something wrong?
faq.a: AI agents check with a person when they’re unsure, and a person reviews the work before it reaches you or your customers. Every automation has an owner and a backup plan.

faq.q: Do we have to change our software?
faq.a: We start with the tools you already use and connect them, with tools like Make, n8n and Zapier. For older systems with no easy way to connect, AI can operate the program the way a person would.
Your data stays where you decide, and we never use it to train anything you don’t own.
AI automation projects start from [PRICE], with a fixed quote before work starts. AI usage, like model fees, is passed on at cost and shown on your invoice.
